description: Tested, immutable Crystra workflow combinations. Fewer agents and LLM calls through explicit, verifiable workflows. One DSH plugin: dsh-crystra.
Self-contained Crystra contracts, schemas, resources and conformance validation.
Host-neutral Crystra runtime library: binds an exact Workflow Package to a Delivery, coordinates execution and emits bounded observations.
Crystra UI component library and independently built UI artifacts.
Crystra Evidence service: bounded observation ingestion, factual projections and inspection.
Crystra Evolution service: evaluates proposed Workflow changes using explicit contracts and Evidence.
Versioned Crystra Workflow definitions, resources and release tooling.
The single dsh-crystra plugin for DeepSeek Harness: workflow execution, analysis and deterministic initialization.
